description:
## Why This Exists

store/backfill.rs::split_at_blank_line() is a one-line wrapper around crate::post::split_header_body() with no meaningful behaviour of its own. It allocates two Vec<u8> where split_header_body returns borrowed slices. The wrapper exists solely to hide the to_vec() calls, but adds noise and an unnecessary extra allocation step.

## Acceptance Criteria

Inline split_at_blank_line at its single call site, or remove it and call split_header_body + to_vec() directly.
title: Readability: backfill.rs split_at_blank_line is a thin wrapper with no doc comment
